{{Quote|It was my one failure, out on the Fringes. The one time when understanding a race's art gave me no insight at all into its psyche. At least not at the time. Now, I believe I'm finally beginning to understand them.''"<br />"''I'm sure that will prove useful in the future.''"<br />"''I doubt it. I wound up destroying their world.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]|<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] '''bombarded''' the<ref name="Hyperspace" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Oben system/Legends|Oben system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Hyperspace" /> [[Oben]]<ref name="GAW" /> after Thrawn failed to understand its inhabitants, the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]], by studying their art.<ref name="Hyperspace" />
